$comment: Structure for a tracking plan. Only meta and events are required; every other key is optional and its tab is skipped when absent. Field notes are in _doc keys, which the builder ignores.

meta.subtitle: one paragraph shown under the title on tab 1: counts, what the grades mean, where to start
meta.the_ask: the single paragraph a stakeholder should read first: what you want built, and what you are NOT asking for
meta.phase1_intro: how to read the build tab, and how the work splits between client and backend

phase1_config: a setup step that is not an event: property config, identity, registration, exclusions

packs.name: Cart & order
packs.purpose: one line on what this pack is for and when it attaches

params.name: transaction_id
params.req: required | conditional | optional | see owner | n/a - SDK
params.transport: event param | items[] | SDK identity | cross-reference
params.values: the value list or a realistic example, never status prose
params.notes: the condition if conditional, plus anything an engineer would otherwise guess

user_properties.name: user_state
user_properties.update: when it is set and when it is cleared

events.name: purchase
events.trigger: the precise moment it fires, in the app's own vocabulary
extra_params: only params not already in an attached pack
events.kpi: which KPI or known gap this serves
events.screens: SCR-45, SCR-37   (or a stated reason when there is no surface to photograph)
events.why_p1: Phase 1 only: why this earns a place now
events.work: Phase 1 only: where the work lands, e.g. 'FE - one line' or 'BE - one hook'
events.notes: anything else, including merge history and open questions

journeys.name: Menu to order
journeys.baseline: the measured baseline today, if known

journey_map: what the user sees and does
open_questions: what the plan asserts and why it is uncertain

_constraints._doc: Shape rules the builder relies on. validate_plan.py checks the ones it can; these are the rest.
_constraints.roadmap: Each row is [label, scope, count, trigger, benefit]. The label may be anything, but if it contains 'Phase 1', 'Phase 2' or 'Phase 3' the row is tinted to match. A label without a phase number is fine and is simply left untinted.
_constraints.events[].screens: Either a comma-separated list of SCR-nn references matching files in tracking_plan_screens/, or a plain sentence saying why there is no screen. Never leave it empty: a blank reads as an oversight, a stated reason reads as a decision.
_constraints.events[].packs: Strings of the form 'PACKID' or 'PACKID (param, param)'. The pack id must exist in packs[] and every named parameter must exist in that pack, or validate_plan.py blocks the build.
_constraints.events[].extra_params: Strictly additive. A parameter already carried by an attached pack must not be repeated here.
_constraints.meta.destination: One of ga4, amplitude, mixpanel, posthog, segment, generic. Drives which limits validate_plan.py checks against. Defaults to ga4 when absent.
_constraints.meta.limits: Optional account-level overrides. Honoured by both the builder and the validator, so they cannot disagree about the same file.
_constraints.any string value: A value starting with = + - or @ is parsed as a formula by every spreadsheet application and renders as an error. validate_plan.py blocks these.
